CADASTRE.Title: Cadastre
CADASTRE.GMOnly: Only the GM can create and edit Cadastre maps.

Manager.Title: Cadastre: maps
Manager.Empty: No maps yet. Start with “New map”.
Manager.DeleteConfirm: Delete the map {name}? An already exported scene is left untouched.

Hints.select: Click: select, drag: move. Selected wall: drag nodes and handles (Alt: independent handles), double-click a node: corner ↔ curve, double-click the wall: new node. Del: delete, Ctrl+D: duplicate.
Hints.brush: Drag to paint the floor freehand. Alt: erases the floor.
Hints.shape: Rectangle, ellipse: drag (Shift: square, circle). Pen: click for a corner, click-drag for a curve, click the first point or Enter to close.
Hints.wall: Pen: click for a corner, click-drag for a curve, Enter or double-click to finish, click the first point to close. Freehand: drag.
Hints.door: Click a wall to place a door.
Hints.prop: Click to place. R and Shift+R: rotate by 15°.
Hints.pan: Right click, middle button or Space + click: pan. Wheel: zoom. Esc: cancel the path.

Panel.NoSelection: Nothing selected. Click a wall, a door or an object.
Panel.Name: Name
Panel.ApplyHint: Anything outside the new size is clipped (Ctrl+Z to go back).

Export.Title: Export to scene
Export.Choice: This map already has a scene: {scene}. Updating it replaces its background and the walls placed by Cadastre; tokens, lights and hand-placed walls stay.
Export.Empty: The map is empty: nothing to export.
Export.Reduced: Very large map: the image is reduced to {size} px per side, Foundry stretches it to the scene size.
